purpose: Describe and freeze pre-training preparation and cache reuse after user confirmation; no current job modification

sequence.operation: Obtain and retain original published files and source metadata
sequence.frequency: once per dataset version, currently available locally
sequence.kaggle_policy: Use a prepared dataset bundle; do not unpack hundreds of thousands of original snippet files for each GPU task

sequence.operation: Resolve sample ID, entity ID, source file, original time order and label provenance
sequence.CH: Use archived sample IDs and normal entity splits; do not recreate charge/discharge segments or randomly split windows
sequence.Brand1: New fixed normal-entity70/10/20 split; use union of archived metadata and shared raw pack; original directory names and old fold memberships do not define new partitions.
sequence.labels: LFP/NCM final evaluation at snippet level; Brand1 at entity level; no fabricated point labels

sequence.operation: Extract the existing seven channels, preserve native ordering, convert to float32 model-input representation
sequence.omitted_fields: CH individual cell voltage columns; timestamps, charge-status field, identifiers and labels are not network inputs
sequence.precision_disclosure: Packed float32 matches the existing input loader; it is not a byte-identical copy of every original source column. TranAD subsequently receives float64 inputs.

sequence.operation: Handle missing values and validate numerical inputs
sequence.frequency: once when preparing input values, retain per-file counts
sequence.CH_existing: Numeric coercion; within-snippet row-order linear interpolation; forward/backward fill; all-missing channel filled with zero
sequence.Brand1_existing: np.nan_to_num: NaN to zero, positive/negative infinity to float32 limits
sequence.already_packed_limit: A cleaned pack cannot reconstruct original missing-value locations; original-file audit is needed to record those counts
sequence.task_assumption: Offline snippet detection; interpolation can use later points in the same snippet
sequence.confirmed_partial_missing_rule: Within each snippet/channel: treat NaN and infinities as missing; interpolate gaps between valid observations and fill endpoints from nearest valid neighbor. Record invalid-value origins; do not clip finite anomaly magnitudes.
sequence.whole_missing_channel_proposal: Confirmed 2026-11-12: fill entirely missing snippet/channel with per-fold normal-training valid-observation median, record affected IDs and positions. Do not include imputed zeros or validation/test in fitting.
sequence.whole_training_channel_unavailable: If the variable has no valid normal-training observations, no statistically supported fallback exists; resolve the input/schema issue before launching that affected job.
sequence.shared_cache_compatibility: Shared cleaned unnormalized pack can retain unresolved whole-channel missing markers; apply fold-specific fallback at batch load, never use one global median fitted across folds.
sequence.legacy_cache_reuse: Old zero-filled cached values cannot reveal which zeros were originally missing; rebuild affected input packs from original files, not by replacing every zero.
sequence.long_gap_policy: Record missing fraction and longest gap; do not automatically drop samples or introduce smoothing. Any exclusion threshold needs a separate explicit rule.
sequence.finite_check_location: Require finite model input after all declared imputations; distinguish malformed raw measurements from runtime NaN/Inf in model loss or gradients.
sequence.whole_missing_status: confirmed; original-file audit in progress, implementation and bundle rebuild pending

sequence.operation: Apply common retained cohort and freeze partition indices
sequence.frequency: once per cohort version, reused across model seeds
sequence.exclude_record: Keep exact excluded IDs and reasons; no performance-driven exclusion
sequence.split_rules: LFP/NCM archived entity splits unchanged; Brand1 fixed normal entities117/16/35 seed0, all30fault entities test. Same manifest for all models/seeds; no separate calibration holdout.

sequence.operation: Store cleaned, unnormalized model-input values once with boundaries and metadata
sequence.CH_layout: Contiguous points x 7 plus snippet offsets/lengths; packed contiguity never permits a cross-snippet window
sequence.Brand1_layout: 476739 x 128 x 7 float32, one original snippet per first-axis row
sequence.fold_layout: One immutable row-index partition per split; Brand1 current single70/10/20 split references unchanged shared raw values. Historical fivefold packs are not rewritten.
sequence.CH_status: Full new-protocol packs not yet built; current timing pack contains NCM train/validation only

sequence.operation: Fit and save normalization statistics using only retained normal training points
sequence.frequency: once per dataset/fold/input version, not per model seed or epoch
sequence.point_weighting: Each real training point counted once, not repeatedly through overlapping windows
sequence.current_timing_small_denominator_rule: For minmax width/std < 1e-12, use denominator 1; no clipping to [0,1]
sequence.legacy_Brand1_rule_disclosure: Old Brand1 helper uses max(width,1e-6); do not silently mix this helper with current timing preprocessing. Differences must be checked before reuse.
sequence.DC_RevIN: Preserved inside native model; it is not replaced by the saved global scaler
sequence.test_validation_use: Frozen transform only; no fitting statistics on validation/test
sequence.confirmed_method: 2026-11-12用户确认：所有模型统一逐变量MinMax，相同正常训练点拟合、每数据集/折冻结；不按片段拟合，不裁剪。极差<1e-12时除数设为1。
sequence.reference_deviations: AT/DC external StandardScaler -> MinMax; native internal normalization preserved
sequence.new_Brand1_split_policy: Refit MinMax on new training rows only; old fold0 scaler is not valid for this split. Refit is required before training, not performed by the metadata split generator.

sequence.operation: Verify and publish the reusable input bundle
sequence.frequency: once per bundle revision; upload only when authorized
sequence.startup_policy: Use explicit mounted bundle path and version; check manifest/schema/counts, avoid recursive scans over all original files and repeated full raw preprocessing
sequence.network_time: Not measured; depends on package size and transfer bandwidth, not GPU training time

sequence.operation: At task startup load shared values, partition indices and frozen scaler
sequence.frequency: once per process; reuse while switching models/folds
sequence.preferred_runtime: Load raw model-input float32 values into RAM when memory budget permits; per-batch scaling instead of writing normalized fold files
sequence.memory_limit_behavior: Propose a disclosed sequential/mmap loading alternative if insufficient RAM; never silently change input count, batch, precision, or sample order

sequence.operation: Construct compact window index mapping and model-specific input/target batches on demand
sequence.frequency: mapping per model window rule; data gathering per batch
sequence.tail_rule: Append a tail-aligned valid window if needed and not already present; never cross snippet boundaries
sequence.index_layout: Arithmetic mapping for equal-length snippets, cumulative counts for variable lengths; avoid per-window Python tuple objects
sequence.sampling: Retain per-model native shuffle and seed semantics. Validate batch membership/order before substituting a compact sampler.
sequence.native_remainder: Omni training retains drop_last policy at effective batch500; record exact omitted windows (up to499). Validation/test retain partial batches, sample-weighted loss and original50-window noise groups.

sequence.operation: Initialize the declared model/optimizer/device and check the first batch
sequence.checks: Input dimensions, target alignment, finite values, memory, first forward/backward; preserve declared model and precision
sequence.timing: Record environment import/model initialization separately from data preparation and epoch compute

cache_policy.weight_dependent_artifacts: Features, residuals and calibration must be tied to exact reconstruction weights; they are not universal dataset inputs
cache_policy.deletion: No existing cache deleted by this draft

timing_limits: Sample-based original-file parsing extrapolations and local complete packed-read/statistics measurements; no end-to-end preparation or Kaggle timing claimed

user_confirmed_20261112.cache_policy: Use the recommended shared input arrays, fold indices, frozen scalers and lazy windows
user_confirmed_20261112.missing_values: Do not blanket-fill with zero; use within-snippet interpolation and neighboring values
user_confirmed_20261112.RCR_training: Dataset preparation applies to RCR reconstruction too; reusable data caches do not authorize checkpoint reuse
user_confirmed_20261112.whole_missing_action: Use per-fold per-variable median from valid original normal-training observations; record imputation fraction. No validation/test fitting.
user_confirmed_20261112.omni_validation: max 10 epochs; once per full training epoch
user_confirmed_20261112.normalization: 2026-11-12用户确认：所有模型统一逐变量MinMax，相同正常训练点拟合、每数据集/折冻结；不按片段拟合，不裁剪。极差<1e-12时除数设为1。
user_confirmed_20261112.Brand1_stride_and_folds: Brand1 train stride5 for MTAD/TranAD/DC/Omni; fixed fold0 only; validation/inference stride unchanged; LFP/NCM stride unchanged
user_confirmed_20261112.Omni_batch: All stages physical500; preserve50-window noise groups; train update once per500, no LR/epoch change

always_check: resolved runtime arguments versus approved plan
code and data versions versus valid evidence
partition IDs, entity separation, window/target schema
seed, fresh initialization/resume scope, precision, device, output destination
first-batch finite inputs, expected shapes and gradient paths
rerun_full_checks_on: model or runner or loss or scoring change
data cleaner or feature order or split or scaler change
window or target or aggregation change
per_job_verification_contract.evidence: Per-task preflight manifest with passed/failed/not_checked, evidence paths, actual values and version fingerprints; missing required evidence is not a pass
runtime_monitor: finite losses/gradients and exact window counts
completion coverage and object-score mapping before report inclusion
per_job_verification_contract.not_a_guarantee: Mechanical checks catch declared mismatches; they cannot establish algorithm correctness without source review and targeted numerical references.

implementation_required_before_formal_la: integrate local/Kaggle formal entry with shared gate and complete native scoring checks

original_missing_audit_result.meaning: No NaN/Inf/float32-overflow in retained original seven-channel inputs. New interpolation/whole-channel fallback rules are inactive on this dataset revision. Pack identity/equivalence is a separate check.

brand1_split_preparation.formal_runner_integration: pending; metadata generation alone does not authorize or start full training

confirmed_prepared_only_execution: 2026-11-12 user: preserve prepared inputs; all subsequent local/Kaggle experiments consume the same versioned prepared data, not original files.
implementation_boundary: New LFP stride runner enforces prepared-only consumption. Historical entrypoints are not automatically migrated; their formal launches must first be adapted.
